title: Design System: Whose Smoke Is It?

display.purpose: The plaque's PM2.5 figure only; tabular lining figures that tick to new values. 46px on mobile.

headline.purpose: Uppercase place name on the plaque; same voice for the drawer title (30px) and wordmark (23px).

title.purpose: Drawer section heads in gold-light; popup heads at 18px in white.

body.purpose: Findings (15.5px, 40ch), caption (19px), drawer text (15px, 62ch), notes (13–13.5px cream-soft).

label.purpose: Cloth tags, band chip (14px), border label, search-result names; mini tags at 13px.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: The plaque floating over the map cloth.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Search result list; map popups use 0 14px 30px.

shadows.name: border-lift
shadows.purpose: Embroidered border casting upward onto the map.

shadows.name: thread-proud
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under the thread (#14040a at 50%, translate 0.9/1.6, blur 1), satin diamonds, cross-stitches and the needle.

motion.name: tag-state
motion.purpose: Tag background, colour and stitch-edge changes on hover/press.

motion.name: cloth-ease
motion.purpose: Caption rise (520ms, 6px lift, 2px blur clearing) and drawer slide (380ms, 32px).

motion.name: sew
motion.purpose: The thread drawn along the real trace; fires light as the needle reaches them.

motion.name: fire-light
motion.purpose: Satin diamond icon-opacity transition as each fire lights.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: Fixed-figure counters turning over to a new value.

motion.name: season-step
motion.purpose: Season playback cadence along the border.

motion.name: camera
motion.purpose: Map moves to a searched place or to frame the trace.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: CSS animation and transition off; sew, tick and camera resolve instantly.

components.name: Cloth Tag
components.description: The default control everywhere: translucent cloth hemmed in a dashed running stitch.
components.css: .ds-cloth { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 16px; background-color: var(--ground-night, #2a0810); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-tag { font: 600 15px/1 var(--display, "Khand", "Mukta", system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--cream, #e9d7b8); background: rgba(30, 6, 12, 0.35); border: 1.5px dashed var(--stitch, rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.55)); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 11px 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1), color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-tag:hover { background: rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.1); border-color: rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.8); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light, #ffd977); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Pressed Tag (White Silk)
components.description: A chosen toggle (city preset, direction, pause): satin-filled in white silk, never gold.

components.name: Embroidered Border
components.description: The season timeline (canvas in the build): running-stitch hems, a PM2.5 strip, gold satin columns of fire activity on the air's path, and a white needle.
components.html: Delhi
components.css: .ds-border { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; gap: 4px; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; height: 122px; padding: 8px 16px 6px; background-color: var(--ground-night, #2a0810); box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(12, 2, 6, 0.45); } .ds-border-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-mini { font: 600 13px/1 var(--display, "Khand", "Mukta", system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--cream, #e9d7b8); background: rgba(30, 6, 12, 0.35); border: 1.5px dashed var(--stitch, rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.55)); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 9px 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1), border-color 160ms; } .ds-mini:hover { background: rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.1); border-color: rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.8); } .ds-mini:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light, #ffd977); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-border-label { font: 600 15px var(--display, "Khand", "Mukta", system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--cream, #e9d7b8); } .ds-border-cloth { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 7px 1fr; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 18px 6px; border-top: 1.2px dashed rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.5); border-bottom: 1.2px dashed rgba(246, 238, 219, 0.5); } .ds-pm-strip, .ds-cols { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-pm-strip i { flex: 1; height: 7px; } .ds-cols { align-items: flex-end; } .ds-cols i { flex: 1; min-height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f2b632 0 55%, #a86c0c 55%); } .ds-needle { position: absolute; left: 62%; top: 4px; bottom: 2px; width: 2px; background: var(--white, #f6eedb); } .ds-needle::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -3.5px; top: -2px; width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--white, #f6eedb); transform: rotate(45deg) scaleY(1.15); }

components.name: Satin Diamond (fire mark)
components.description: A satellite fire as a gold satin-stitch lozenge with diagonal silk floats; unlit fires are dull floss. Lights over 260ms as the needle passes.
components.css: .ds-ground { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background-color: var(--ground, #5a1521); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-fire { display: inline-block; width: 44px; height: 44px; filter: drop-shadow(0.8px 1.4px 0 rgba(20, 4, 8, 0.55)); transition: opacity 260ms; } .ds-fire::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; clip-path: polygon(50% 6%, 81.7% 50%, 50% 94%, 18.3% 50%); background: repeating-linear-gradient(121deg, #ffd977 0 2px, #a86c0c 2px 3.1px, #f2b632 3.1px 5.1px, #a86c0c 5.1px 6.2px, #f2b632 6.2px 8.2px, #a86c0c 8.2px 9.3px); } .ds-fire-dim { opacity: 0.38; } .ds-fire-dim::before { background: repeating-linear-gradient(121deg, #a8862f 0 2px, #6b4a16 2px 3.1px, #8a6b22 3.1px 5.1px, #6b4a16 5.1px 6.2px, #8a6b22 6.2px 8.2px, #6b4a16 8.2px 9.3px); }

components.name: Running Thread
components.description: The traced air: one bright white running stitch with a proud contact shadow, over faint 32% sibling threads. Peacock replaces white in forward mode.
components.css: .ds-ground { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background-color: var(--ground, #5a1521); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-thread path { fill: none; } .ds-sib { stroke: #f6eedb; stroke-opacity: 0.32; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-dasharray: 1.54 1.76; } .ds-shadow { stroke: #14040a; stroke-opacity: 0.5; stroke-width: 5.6; stroke-linecap: round; transform: translate(0.9px, 1.6px); filter: blur(1px); } .ds-main { stroke: #f6eedb; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 7.2 4.4; } .ds-fwd .ds-sib, .ds-fwd .ds-main { stroke: #4fc3c9; }

components.name: City Knot Pin
components.description: Preset cities on the map as French knots with a Khand name; the active city is a gold-satin knot with a larger gold-light name.
components.css: .ds-ground { display: inline-flex; gap: 20px; padding: 16px; background-color: var(--ground, #5a1521); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-pin { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; font: 600 16px/1 var(--display, "Khand", "Mukta", system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--cream, #e9d7b8); text-shadow: 0 0 3px #3e0c17, 0 1px 2px #3e0c17, 0 0 8px #3e0c17; } .ds-knot { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--white, #f6eedb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #3e0c17, 0 1.5px 3px 3px rgba(12, 2, 6, 0.6); } .ds-pin:hover .ds-nm { color: var(--white, #f6eedb); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light, #ffd977); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-active .ds-knot { background: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, #f2b632 0 3px, #ffd977 3px 4.5px, #e9a91f 4.5px 7px); } .ds-active .ds-nm { color: var(--gold-light, #ffd977); font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview:
The map is a length of madder-maroon handspun khaddar, and everything on it is needlework. Rivers and region lines are indigo thread sunk into the weave; farm fires are gold satin-stitch diamonds; the air a place breathed is a white running stitch sewn back along the real hourly wind, with nine faint sibling threads showing how sure the path is. Forward smoke is sewn in peacock thread. The season runs along the bottom as an embroidered border. Controls are cloth tags hemmed in running stitch.

The surface is full-bleed and map-led. Floating panels are pieces of the same cloth, a shade darker, with a stitched inner hem. Density stays low: one plaque, one tool row, one border, one bright thread. Motion follows the data: the thread is sewn at the pace of the wind trace, fires light as the needle passes, and counts tick over in fixed figures.

Confirmed rejection: the near-black dashboard map with glowing dots and a stats sidebar.
keyCharacteristics: Maroon cloth ground with a 6px weave texture over everything, map included.
Tags, fields and panel hems are edged in dashed running stitch; chosen things are satin-filled.
One bright edge: only the traced centre thread is a full-strength line.
Khand condensed caps for names and figures, Mukta for reading text, tabular figures that tick.
Soft, deep maroon-black shadows; nothing glows.

rules.name: The One Bright Thread Rule
rules.body: Only the traced centre thread is a full-strength white line (peacock forward). Sibling threads sit at 32%, country borders at 30% cream, region lines at 70% indigo, unlit fires at 14–38%. If another line is as bright as the thread, dim it.

rules.name: The Silk Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gold satin fill marks fire and the one primary action in a panel. A chosen toggle gets white silk, never gold. Peacock appears only in forward mode.

rules.name: The Fixed Figure Rule
rules.body: Every counted figure is Khand with `tabular-nums lining-nums`, and it ticks to its new value over 520ms (ease-out cubic) rather than swapping. Inline figures in prose are gold-light at 1.12em.

rules.name: The Model Thread Rule
rules.body: Modelled data looks unfinished. A modelled PM2.5 numeral drops to cream with a 2px dashed underline (offset 8px); modelled cells in the border's PM strip drop to 45% opacity and 60% height.

rules.name: The Proud Thread Rule
rules.body: Stitches cast only a soft ~1px contact shadow, as thread on cloth would. Nothing on the cloth emits light.

rules.name: The Running Stitch Edge Rule
rules.body: Controls, panel hems and traced paths are dashed stitches, never solid strokes: tags and fields at 1.5px, panel hems at 32% white, the thread at 1.8/1.1 dash, siblings at 1.4/1.6, the border hems at 5/4. Only the basemap's sunk lines (indigo regions and districts, 30% cream borders) stay solid.

dos: Do set every new surface on night madder (ground-night) with the weave texture and a 6px-inset dashed hem.
Do make every panel control a cloth tag: 1.5px dashed stitch, 7px radius, Khand 600 label.
Do keep the sew tied to the data: the thread draws over 2200ms (ease-out cubic) along the real trace, and fires light only as the needle reaches them.
Do pair every AQI colour with its band name or a number; the colour never stands alone.
Do honour reduced motion: CSS animation off, and the sew, ticks and camera moves resolve instantly.
Do bundle Khand and Mukta locally; no font or library CDN.
donts: Don't build a near-black dashboard map with glowing dots and a stats sidebar.
Don't draw the air path as a solid, glowing or gradient line; it is always running stitch with a proud shadow.
Don't put gold satin on a toggle or a second action in the same panel; chosen toggles are white silk.
Don't use peacock outside forward mode, or for anything but the forward thread, its marks and the towns beneath it.
Don't let any other line on the map match the traced thread's brightness.
